Label: k-means clustering
Description: A k-means clustering is a data transformation which achieves a class discovery or partitioning objective, which takes as input a collection of objects (represented as points in multidimensional space) and which partitions them into a specified number k of clusters. The algorithm attempts to find the centers of natural clusters in the data. The most common form of the algorithm starts by partitioning the input points into k initial sets, either at random or using some heuristic data. It then calculates the mean point, or centroid, of each set. It constructs a new partition by associating each point with the closest centroid. Then the centroids are recalculated for the new clusters, and the algorithm repeated by alternate applications of these two steps until convergence, which is obtained when the points no longer switch clusters (or alternatively centroids are no longer changed).

Label: hierarchical clustering
Description: A hierarchical clustering is a data transformation which achieves a class discovery objective, which takes as input data item and builds a hierarchy of clusters. The traditional representation of this hierarchy is a tree (visualized by a dendrogram), with the individual input objects at one end (leaves) and a single cluster containing every object at the other (root).

Label: Unit
Description: A property representing the unit of measure in which a nutrient or food component is typically expressed, ex., gram (g), minigram (mg), microgram (mcg), joule, or kilojoule.

Label: Essential_Amino_Acid
Description: A property used to indicate that an amino acid is essential and must be included in the diet.

Label: Essential_Fatty_Acid
Description: A property used to indicate a fatty acid that is not efficiently synthesized by humans and must be included in the diet.

Label: Extensible_List
Description: A property representing the ability to extend the set of values in a particular list.

Label: miRBase_ID
Description: A property representing the accession number for an miRNA within the Sanger miRBase database.

Label: Neoplastic_Status
Description: A property representing the morphologic, clinical, and genetic profile of a neoplastic growth that defines it as benign, malignant, or of uncertain cancerous potential.

Label: OLD_ASSOCIATION
Description: A property used to store the name and value of associations present at the time a concept was retired.

Label: OLD_SOURCE_ASSOCIATION
Description: A property used to temporarily store the name and value of associations present at the time a concept is premerged or preretired, where the target of the association is the concept being retired. Values stored in this property are restored as associations on the source concept if the merge or retire is rejected.

Label: Legacy Concept Name
Description: A property representing a retired unique concept identifier created and stored as Concept Name by legacy EVS software. Use of these values was long discouraged, but continued as late as 2009 when creation of new values ceased and Concept Name was retired. Legacy values are intended solely to help resolve and update earlier coding.

Label: PID_ID
Description: A property representing the NCI/Nature Pathway Interaction Database (PID) code for a pathway. It can be used by the NCIt Browser to link a pathway concept to the source pathway information.

Label: CHEBI_ID
Description: A property representing that a concept in the 'Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material' branch of the NCI thesaurus maps to a specific concept in the EBI Chemical Entities of Biological Interest (CHEBI) database.

Label: HGNC_ID
Description: A property representing that a concept in the 'Gene' branch of the NCI thesaurus maps to a HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee (HGNC) certified gene.

Label: NICHD_Hierarchy_Term
Description: A property representing a term chosen by NICHD to be used in the representation of the NICHD hierarchy.

Label: Publish_Value_Set
Description: A property representing whether a value set is ready for publication in the browser.

Label: Maps_To
Description: A property representing that a term in another terminology has been mapped to a term in NCIt and describes the relationship between the mapped terms.

Label: Term_Browser_Value_Set_Description
Description: A property used to house the text on the introductory page on the NCI Term Browser for the Value Set named by a concept when that text differs from the DEFINITION for that concept.

Label: Value_Set_Pair
Description: A property that indicates whether or not a value set is part of a paired set of codelists for publication processing purposes.

Label: NCI_Drug_Dictionary_ID
Description: A property representing the numerical CDR ID, which is the NCI Drug Dictionary identifier for a chemical or pharmaceutical agent.

Label: ClinVar_Variation_ID
Description: A property representing the numerical Variation ID assigned to a molecular abnormality entry by ClinVar.

Label: Subsource
Description: A property used by MMHCC to identify the source of various mouse disease concepts.

Label: Swiss_Prot
Description: A property representing the accession number for a protein within the Swiss-Prot database.

Label: Gene_Encodes_Product
Description: A property representing the protein or RNA product expressed by a gene.

Label: DesignNote
Description: A property representing notations made by NCI vocabulary curators. They are intended to provide supplemental, unstructured information to the user or additional insight about the concept.

Label: Disease_Has_Associated_Anatomic_Site
Description: A role used to relate a disease to the general site, structure or system where the specific pathological process is located. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 660 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Has_Primary_Anatomic_Site
Description: A role used to relate a disease to the anatomical site where the originating pathological process is located. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 3,532 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Has_Metastatic_Anatomic_Site
Description: A role used to relate a disease to the site of a metastatic lesion associated with the disease. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 250 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Has_Normal_Tissue_Origin
Description: A role used to relate a disease to the type of normal tissue in which the disease process began. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 796 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Has_Normal_Cell_Origin
Description: A role used to relate a disease to the type of normal cell in which the disease process begins. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 808 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Has_Abnormal_Cell
Description: A role used to relate a disease to the type of neoplastic cell present in and characteristic of the disease. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Abnormal Cell', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,390 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Has_Molecular_Abnormality
Description: A role used to relate a disease to a molecular abnormality that is present in the specified disease state. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Molecular Abnormality', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 866 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Has_Cytogenetic_Abnormality
Description: A role used to relate a disease to the type of chromosomal abnormality present in the specified disease state. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Molecular Abnormality', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 328 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Has_Finding
Description: A role used to relate a disease to a clinical observation, sign or symptom present in and characteristic of the disease. Both the domain and range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding'. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 7,400 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Is_Grade
Description: A role used to relate a disease to a grading system which classifies the cancer cells in terms of how abnormal they appear when examined under a microscope. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Property or_Attribute', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 284 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_May_Have_Normal_Tissue_Origin
Description: A role used to represent that a normal tissue type will only be the type of origin in some cases of the disease. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 4 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_May_Have_Normal_Cell_Origin
Description: A role used to represent that a normal cell type will only be the type of origin in some cases of the disease. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 26 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_May_Have_Abnormal_Cell
Description: A role used to represent that particular neoplastic cell types will only be present in some cases of the disease. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Abnormal Cell', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 720 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_May_Have_Cytogenetic_Abnormality
Description: A role used to represent that a particular cytogenetic abnormality will only be present in some cases of the disease. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Molecular Abnormality', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,888 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_May_Have_Finding
Description: A role used to represent that a clinical observation, sign or symptom will only be observed in some cases of the disease. Both the domain and range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding'. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 5,786 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_May_Have_Associated_Disease
Description: A role used to represent that another disease or disorder will only be observed in some cases of the specified disease. Both the domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding'. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,250 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Chemical_Or_Drug_Is_Metabolized_By_Enzyme
Description: A role used to specify that an enzyme is directly responsible for metabolizing a chemical or drug into an active form, inactive form, or both. The domain and range for this role are 'Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material' and 'Gene Product', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 712 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Chemotherapy_Regimen_Has_Component
Description: A role used to specify the component agents which are used in a particular chemotherapy regimen or agent combination. The domain and the range for this role are 'Chemotherapy Regimen or Agent Combination' and 'Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 27,906 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Chemical_Or_Drug_Has_Mechanism_Of_Action
Description: A role used to imply the interaction or binding of an active ingredient of a drug/chemical agent at the molecular level with its target. When possible, the role value should reflect the direct alteration of function of a target molecule or complex. The domain and range for this role are 'Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material' and 'Biological Process', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,356 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Chemical_Or_Drug_Has_Physiologic_Effect
Description: A role used to describe the primary detectable alterations of subcellular, cellular, tissue, or organ functions that directly result from alteration of function of a target biological molecule or complex caused by interaction of a therapeutic agent with a target molecule or complex. The domain and range for this role are 'Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material' and 'Biological Process', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,910 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Has_Associated_Disease
Description: A role used to relate a disease to another disease or disorder, but without specification or limitation of the relationship (causality or timing for example). Both the domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding'. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 592 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Gene_Is_Element_In_Pathway
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a gene and a biochemical pathway in which its encoded gene product(s) participate. This relationship is used only when gene has been implicated in a pathway by the curated source (Biocarta, KEGG or PID). The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Biochemical Pathway', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 30,644 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Gene_Product_Is_Element_In_Pathway
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a gene product and a biochemical pathway in which it participates. This relationship is used only when a gene product has been implicated in a pathway by the curated source (Biocarta, KEGG or PID). The domain and range for this role are 'Gene Product' and 'Biochemical Pathway', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 30,866 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Gene_Has_Abnormality
Description: A role used to establish a link between a gene and the genetic or molecular abnormalities that have been observed in human cells and tissues associated with cancers (e.g., over- or under-expressed, amplified, translocated). The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Molecular Abnormality', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 216 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Gene_Product_Has_Abnormality
Description: A role used to establish a link between a gene product and the molecular abnormalities that are observed in human cells and tissues in association with diseases such as cancers (e.g., over or under-expression of gene product). The domain and range for this role are 'Gene Product' and 'Molecular Abnormality', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 56 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Excludes_Primary_Anatomic_Site
Description: A specializing role which may be used to override Disease_Has_Associated_Anatomic_Site. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 306 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Excludes_Metastatic_Anatomic_Site
Description: A specializing role which may be used to override Disease_Has_ Metastatic_Anatomic_Site. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 6 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Excludes_Normal_Tissue_Origin
Description: A specializing role which may be used to override Disease_Has_Normal_Tissue_Origin. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 58 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Excludes_Normal_Cell_Origin
Description: A specializing role which may be used to override Disease_Has_Normal_Cell_Origin. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 78 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Excludes_Abnormal_Cell
Description: A specializing role which may be used to override Disease_Has_Abnormal_Cell. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Abnormal Cell', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 514 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Excludes_Molecular_Abnormality
Description: A specializing role which may be used to override Disease_Has_ Molecular_Abnormality. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Molecular Abnormality', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 284 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Excludes_Cytogenetic_Abnormality
Description: A specializing role which may be used to override Disease_Has_Cytogenetic_Abnormality. The domain and the range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Molecular Abnormality', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 136 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Excludes_Finding
Description: A specializing role which may be used to override Disease_Has_Finding. Both the domain and range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding'. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,776 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Gene_Has_Physical_Location
Description: A role used to link a gene with its physical extent on a chromosome, denoted by the chromosome number and start and end base positions (with numbering beginning at the telomere of the short p arm). The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,970 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Chemical_Or_Drug_Affects_Gene_Product
Description: A role used to assert that a gene product is the target of a therapeutic agent. The role implies a direct interaction between the product and the therapeutic agent but it does not specify the type of association (e.g., involvement, interference, inhibition or cleavage). The domain and range for this role are 'Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material' and 'Gene Product', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 636 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Chemical_Or_Drug_Affects_Abnormal_Cell
Description: A role used to establish the relationship between a therapeutic agent and an abnormal cell type associated with a disease condition. By pointing to abnormal cells, the therapeutic target of a drug can be more clearly conveyed. The domain and range for this role are 'Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material' and 'Abnormal Cell', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 56 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Allele_Has_Abnormality
Description: A specializing role which may be used to override Gene_Has_Abnormality that has been asserted for the gene class. This role is used to establish a link between a specific allele and genetic or molecular abnormalities that have been observed in human cells and tissues associated with cancer or another disease of interest. The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Molecular Abnormality', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 366 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Allele_In_Chromosomal_Location
Description: A role used for an allele whose location has changed from the wild-type gene chromosomal location. This role is used to assert a new location that differs from the wild-type gene chromosomal location. The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 212 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Allele_Absent_From_Wild-type_Chromosomal_Location
Description: A role used for an allele whose location has changed from the wild-type gene chromosomal location. This role is used to negate an inherited role relationship that is asserted between the parent gene class and a chromosomal location when an allele has moved (e.g., translocation, inversion, etc.). The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Allele_Plays_Altered_Role_In_Process
Description: A specializing role which may be used for an allele whose encoded product functions differently (qualitatively or quantitatively) from the function asserted on its parent. It specializes the function of the wild type gene/gene product. The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Biological Process', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 256 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Allele_Has_Activity
Description: A role used to assert the observed level of activity associated with an allele in a given biological process, compared to the wild-type gene. The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Property or Attribute', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 148 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Allele_Plays_Role_In_Metabolism_Of_Chemical_Or_Drug
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a specific allele (product; enzyme) and drug-metabolizing efficacy. The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 6 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Procedure_Has_Target_Anatomy
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a procedure and its target anatomy, specifically that a particular procedure always has an association with the target anatomy. This role should be used when a more specific role cannot be asserted, including procedures targeting blood and other fluids. The domain and range for this role are 'Clinical or Research Activity' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 228 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Procedure_Has_Imaged_Anatomy
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between an imaging procedure and its target anatomy, specifically that a particular procedure always involves imaging the specified anatomy. The domain and range for this role are 'Clinical or Research Activity' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Procedure_May_Have_Excised_Anatomy
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a surgical procedure and its target anatomy, specifically that a particular procedure sometimes results in excision of some or all of the specified anatomy. This role is applicable to procedures or techniques that involve excision of solid tissues or organs. It should be used when a more specific role cannot be asserted. The domain and range for this role are 'Clinical or Research Activity' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 12 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Procedure_Has_Excised_Anatomy
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a surgical procedure and its target anatomy, specifically that a particular procedure always involves excision of some or all of the specified anatomy. This role is applicable to procedures or techniques that involve excision of solid tissues or organs. It should be used when a more specific role cannot be asserted. The domain and range for this role are 'Clinical or Research Activity' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 204 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Procedure_May_Have_Partially_Excised_Anatomy
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a surgical procedure and its target anatomy, specifically that a particular procedure sometimes results in partial excision of the specified anatomy. This role is applicable to procedures or techniques that involve excision of solid tissues or organs, and where partial excision is explicit or can be inferred (e.g. biopsy). The domain and range for this role are 'Clinical or Research Activity' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 18 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Procedure_Has_Partially_Excised_Anatomy
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a surgical procedure and its target anatomy, specifically that a particular procedure always involves partial excision of the specified anatomy. This role is applicable to procedures or techniques that involve excision of solid tissues or organs, and where partial excision is explicit or can be inferred (e.g. biopsy). The domain and range for this role are 'Clinical or Research Activity' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 254 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Procedure_May_Have_Completely_Excised_Anatomy
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a surgical procedure and its target anatomy, specifically that a particular procedure sometimes results in complete excision of the target anatomy. This role is applicable to procedures or techniques that involve excision of solid tissues or organs, and where complete excision is explicit or can be inferred. The domain and range for this role are 'Clinical or Research Activity' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 12 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Procedure_Has_Completely_Excised_Anatomy
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a surgical procedure and its target anatomy, specifically that a particular procedure always is intended for the complete excision of the target anatomy. This role is applicable to procedures or techniques that involve excision of solid tissues or organs, and where complete excision is explicit or can be inferred. The domain and range for this role are 'Clinical or Research Activity' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 150 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Regimen_Has_Accepted_Use_For_Disease
Description: A role used to link established therapeutic regimens to their corresponding cancers or other diseases. Only established regimens published in NCI's Physician Data Query (PDQ), National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) Guidelines (http://www.nccn.org), or a limited number of other authoritative sources such as the Physician's Cancer Chemotherapy Manual are included. The domain and range for this role are 'Chemotherapy Regimen or Agent Combination' and 'Disease, Disorder or Finding', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 880 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Cytogenetic_Abnormality_Involves_Chromosome
Description: A role used to assert a direct relationship between a cytogenetic abnormality and a chromosome. The domain and range for this role are 'Cytogenetic Abnormality' and 'Chromosome', respectively. The range for this role excludes chromosomal bands and physical locations. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 922 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Mapped_To_Chromosome
Description: A role used to assert a relationship between a disease, disorder or finding and a chromosome. This restriction should be used when a disease or disorder maps to a chromosome. It is not meant to be used when a specific cytogenetic abnormality is known (e.g. translocation, inversion). The domain and range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Chromosome', respectively. The range for this role excludes chromosomal bands and physical locations. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 400 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Gene_Involved_In_Pathogenesis_Of_Disease
Description: A role used to assert a direct relationship between a gene and a disease. This restriction should only be used when an abnormality in a gene a causative event for a disease. The domain and range for this role are 'Gene' and 'Disease or Disorder', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,484 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Disease_Mapped_To_Gene
Description: A role used to assert a direct relationship between a disease, disorder or finding and a gene. This restriction can be used when a polymorphism or an abnormality in a gene is either a clinical marker for, a causative event for, or predisposes a subject to a disease. The domain and range for this role are 'Disease, Disorder or Finding' and 'Gene', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 4,128 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Molecular_Abnormality_Involves_Gene
Description: A role used to assert a direct relationship between a molecular abnormality and a gene. The domain and range for this role are 'Molecular Abnormality' and 'Gene', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 3,392 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Gene_Mutant_Encodes_Gene_Product_Sequence_Variation
Description: A role used to indicate that a specific molecular variation or mutation in a gene encodes a gene product sequence variant. The domain and range for this role are 'Gene Mutant' and 'Gene Product Sequence Variation', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,472 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Gene_Product_Sequence_Variation_Encoded_By_Gene_Mutant
Description: A role used to indicate that a gene product sequence variation is encoded by a specific gene mutant. The domain and range for this role are 'Gene Product Sequence Variation' and 'Gene Mutant', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,682 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Gene_Product_Variant_Of_Gene_Product
Description: A role used to indicate that a gene product sequence variation is related to a wild-type gene product. The domain and range for this role are 'Gene Product Sequence Variation' and 'Gene Product', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 284 owl:Restrictions.

Label: EO_Disease_Has_Associated_Cell_Type
Description: A role used to specify the associated cell type of a disease in an experimental organism. The domain and range for this role are 'Experimental Organism Diagnosis' and 'Experimental Organism Anatomical Concept', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2 owl:Restrictions.

Label: EO_Disease_Maps_To_Human_Disease
Description: A role is used to establish a relationship between a disease in an experimental organism and a corresponding human disease. The domain and the range for this role are 'Experimental Organism Diagnosis' and 'Disease, Disorder or Finding', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 200 owl:Restrictions.

Label: EO_Disease_Has_Associated_EO_Anatomy
Description: A role used to specify the general site, structure or system where a pathological process is located in an experimental organism. The domain and range for this role are 'Experimental Organism Diagnosis' and 'Experimental Organism Anatomical Concept', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 976 owl:Restrictions.

Label: EO_Disease_Has_Property_Or_Attribute
Description: A role used to specify the clinical behavior, or other characteristic, of a disease in an experimental organism. The domain and range for this role are 'Experimental Organism Diagnosis' and 'Property or Attribute', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 128 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Conceptual_Part_Of
Description: A role used to indicate that a conceptual entity is a sub-entity of another conceptual entity. Both the domain and the range for this role are 'Conceptual Entity'. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 7,170 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Biological_Process_Has_Initiator_Process
Description: A role used to assert that the initiation of the stated biological process is dependent on the progression or completion of another process. The role implies a direct physical and functional interaction of an element from the preceding biological process with a target molecule or complex involved in the initial stages of the stated process. Both the domain and the range for this role are 'Biological Process'. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 58 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Biological_Process_Has_Result_Chemical_Or_Drug
Description: A role used to assert that the endpoint of a biological process is the creation of a drug, chemical or biomedical material. The domain and range for this role are 'Biological Process' and 'Drug, Food, Chemical or Biomedical Material', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 30 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Biological_Process_Has_Associated_Location
Description: A role used to indicate the organ, organ system, cellular or subcellular location where a process occurs in a living system. The domain and range for this role are 'Biological Process' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 174 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Biological_Process_Has_Result_Anatomy
Description: A role used to assert that some biological event results in the formation of a subcellular complex, structure, cell, tissue or organ. This role is used to establish this relationship between the biological process and the anatomical factor formed. The domain and range for this role are 'Biological Process' and 'Anatomic Structure, System, or Substance', respectively. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 66 owl:Restrictions.

Label: Biological_Process_Has_Initiator_Chemical_Or_Drug
Description: A role used to assert the relationship between a biological process and a drug or chemical that stimulates the process. The role implies the direct physical interaction of a chemical or drug with a target molecule or complex that results in the initiation of the process. Description: N1 synapsed_to some N2 Expands to: N1 SubclassOf ( has_part some ( ‘pre-synaptic membrane ; GO:0042734’ that part_of some ( ‘synapse ; GO:0045202’ that has_part some ( ‘post-synaptic membrane ; GO:0045211’ that part_of some N2)))) Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 36 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has synaptic terminal in
Description: A general relation between a neuron and some structure in which it either chemically synapses to some target or in which it receives (chemical) synaptic input. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 8 owl:Restrictions.

Label: overlaps
Description: "(forall (x y) (iff (overlaps x y) (exists (z) (and (part of z x) (part of z y)))))" CLIF [] Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 6,287 owl:Restrictions.

Label: overlaps
Description: "(forall (x y) (iff (overlaps x y) (exists (z) (and (part of z x) (part of z y)))))" CLIF [] Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 6,287 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has fasciculating neuron projection
Description: The relation between a neuron projection bundle and a neuron projection that is fasciculated with it. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 464 owl:Restrictions.

Label: innervates
Description: Relation between a 'neuron projection bundle' and a region in which one or more of its component neuron projections either synapses to targets or receives synaptic input. T innervates some R Expands_to: T has_fasciculating_neuron_projection that synapse_in some R. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,041 owl:Restrictions.

Label: continuous with
Description: X continuous_with Y if and only if X and Y share a fiat boundary. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,560 owl:Restrictions.

Label: partially overlaps
Description: x partially overlaps y iff there exists some z such that z is part of x and z is part of y, and it is also the case that neither x is part of y or y is part of x Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 10 owl:Restrictions.

Label: derived by descent from
Description: d derived_by_descent_from a if d is specified by some genetic program that is sequence-inherited-from a genetic program that specifies a.

Label: shares ancestor with
Description: VBO calls this homologous_to

Label: serially homologous to
Description: Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 9 owl:Restrictions.

Label: only in taxon
Description: x only in taxon y if and only if x is in taxon y, and there is no other organism z such that y!=z a and x is in taxon z. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 433,224 owl:Restrictions.

Label: never in taxon
Description: x never in taxon T if and only if T is a class, and x does not instantiate the class expression "in taxon some T". Note that this is a shortcut relation, and should be used as a hasValue restriction in OWL.

Label: in taxon
Description: Connects a biological entity to its taxon of origin. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 124,751 owl:Restrictions.

Label: spatially disjoint from
Description: A is spatially_disjoint_from B if and only if they have no parts in common

Label: connected to
Description: a is connected to b if and only if a and b are discrete structure, and there exists some connecting structure c, such that c connects a and b Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 642 owl:Restrictions.

Label: mutually spatially disjoint with
Description: A is mutually_spatially_disjoint_with B if both A and B are classes, and there exists no p such that p is part_of some A and p is part_of some B.

Label: ambiguous for taxon
Description: S ambiguous_for_taxon T if the class S does not have a clear referent in taxon T. An example would be the class 'manual digit 1', which encompasses a homology hypotheses that is accepted for some species (e.g. human and mouse), but does not have a clear referent in Aves - the referent is dependent on the hypothesis embraced, and also on the ontogenetic stage. [PHENOSCPAE:asilomar_mtg]

Label: dubious for taxon
Description: This relation lacks a strong logical interpretation, but can be used in place of never_in_taxon where it is desirable to state that the definition of the class is too strict for the taxon under consideration, but placing a never_in_taxon link would result in a chain of inconsistencies that will take ongoing coordinated effort to resolve. Example: metencephalon in teleost

Label: present in taxon
Description: The SPARQL expansion for this relation introduces new named classes into the ontology. For this reason it is likely that the expansion should only be performed during a QC pipeline; the expanded output should usually not be included in a published version of the ontology.

Label: present in taxon
Description: The SPARQL expansion for this relation introduces new named classes into the ontology. For this reason it is likely that the expansion should only be performed during a QC pipeline; the expanded output should usually not be included in a published version of the ontology.

Label: connects
Description: c connects a if and only if there exist some b such that a and b are similar parts of the same system, and c connects b, specifically, c connects a with b. When one structure connects two others it unites some aspect of the function or role they play within the system. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,965 owl:Restrictions.

Label: attached to part of
Description: a is attached to part of b if a is attached to b, or a is attached to some p, where p is part of b. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 92 owl:Restrictions.

Label: supplies
Description: Relation between an arterial structure and another structure, where the arterial structure acts as a conduit channeling fluid, substance or energy.

Label: drains
Description: Relation between an collecting structure and another structure, where the collecting structure acts as a conduit channeling fluid, substance or energy away from the other structure.

Label: has component
Description: w 'has component' p if w 'has part' p and w is such that it can be directly disassembled into into n parts p, p2, p3, ..., pn, where these parts are of similar type. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 3,802 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has phenotype
Description: A relationship that holds between a biological entity and a phenotype. Here a phenotype is construed broadly as any kind of quality of an organism part, a collection of these qualities, or a change in quality or qualities (e.g. abnormally increased temperature). The subject of this relationship can be an organism (where the organism has the phenotype, i.e. the qualities inhere in parts of this organism), a genomic entity such as a gene or genotype (if modifications of the gene or the genotype causes the phenotype), or a condition such as a disease (such that if the condition inheres in an organism, then the organism has the phenotype).

Label: develops from
Description: This is the transitive form of the develops from relation Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 10,983 owl:Restrictions.

Label: develops into
Description: inverse of develops from Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,499 owl:Restrictions.

Label: gene product of
Description: definition "x has gene product of y if and only if y is a gene (SO:0000704) that participates in some gene expression process (GO:0010467) where the output of that process is either y or something that is ribosomally translated from x" Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 796 owl:Restrictions.

Label: directly develops from
Description: TODO - add child relations from DOS Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 63 owl:Restrictions.

Label: directly develops into
Description: inverse of directly develops from Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 4 owl:Restrictions.

Label: regulates
Description: p regulates q iff p is causally upstream of q, the execution of p is not constant and varies according to specific conditions, and p influences the rate or magnitude of execution of q due to an effect either on some enabler of q or some enabler of a part of q. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 12,138 owl:Restrictions.

Label: negatively regulates
Description: p negatively regulates q iff p regulates q, and p decreases the rate or magnitude of execution of q. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 10,576 owl:Restrictions.

Label: positively regulates
Description: p positively regulates q iff p regulates q, and p increases the rate or magnitude of execution of q. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 10,646 owl:Restrictions.

Label: capable of
Description: A relation between a material entity (such as a cell) and a process, in which the material entity has the ability to carry out the process. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 21,802 owl:Restrictions.

Label: capable of
Description: A relation between a material entity (such as a cell) and a process, in which the material entity has the ability to carry out the process. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 21,802 owl:Restrictions.

Label: capable of part of
Description: c stands in this relationship to p if and only if there exists some p' such that c is capable_of p', and p' is part_of p. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,643 owl:Restrictions.

Label: capable of part of
Description: c stands in this relationship to p if and only if there exists some p' such that c is capable_of p', and p' is part_of p. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,643 owl:Restrictions.

Label: surrounded by
Description: x surrounded_by y if and only if (1) x is adjacent to y and for every region r that is adjacent to x, r overlaps y (2) the shared boundary between x and y occupies the majority of the outermost boundary of x Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 170 owl:Restrictions.

Label: adjacent to
Description: x adjacent to y if and only if x and y share a boundary. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,511 owl:Restrictions.

Label: surrounds
Description: inverse of surrounded by Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 243 owl:Restrictions.

Label: temporally related to
Description: A relation that holds between two occurrents. This is a grouping relation that collects together all the Allen relations.

Label: starts
Description: inverse of starts with Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 12 owl:Restrictions.

Label: starts with
Description: x starts with y if and only if x has part y and the time point at which x starts is equivalent to the time point at which y starts. Formally: α(y) = α(x) ∧ ω(y) < ω(x), where α is a function that maps a process to a start point, and ω is a function that maps a process to an end point. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 262 owl:Restrictions.

Label: develops from part of
Description: x develops from part of y if and only if there exists some z such that x develops from z and z is part of y Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 29 owl:Restrictions.

Label: develops in
Description: x develops_in y if x is located in y whilst x is developing Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 22 owl:Restrictions.

Label: ends
Description: inverse of ends with Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 10 owl:Restrictions.

Label: ends with
Description: x ends with y if and only if x has part y and the time point at which x ends is equivalent to the time point at which y ends. Formally: α(y) > α(x) ∧ ω(y) = ω(x), where α is a function that maps a process to a start point, and ω is a function that maps a process to an end point. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 114 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has start location
Description: x 'has starts location' y if and only if there exists some process z such that x 'starts with' z and z 'occurs in' y Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 84 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has end location
Description: x 'has end location' y if and only if there exists some process z such that x 'ends with' z and z 'occurs in' y Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 70 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has input
Description: p has input c iff: p is a process, c is a material entity, c is a participant in p, c is present at the start of p, and the state of c is modified during p. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 3,612 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has output
Description: p has output c iff c is a participant in p, c is present at the end of p, and c is not present in the same state at the beginning of p. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 252 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has exposure route
Description: A broad relationship between an exposure event or process and a process by which the exposure stressor comes into contact with the exposure receptor Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 566 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has exposure transport path
Description: A broad relationship between an exposure event or process and the course takes from the source to the target. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 80 owl:Restrictions.

Label: related via exposure to
Description: Any relationship between an exposure event or process and any other entity. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 22 owl:Restrictions.

Label: connecting branch of
Description: b connecting-branch-of s iff b is connected to s, and there exists some tree-like structure t such that the mereological sum of b plus s is either the same as t or a branching-part-of t. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 466 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has developmental contribution from
Description: x has developmental contribution from y iff x has some part z such that z develops from y Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 372 owl:Restrictions.

Label: developmentally contributes to
Description: inverse of has developmental contribution from

Label: developmentally induced by
Description: t1 induced_by t2 if there is a process of developmental induction (GO:0031128) with t1 and t2 as interacting participants. t2 causes t1 to change its fate from a precursor material anatomical entity type T to T', where T' develops_from T Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 59 owl:Restrictions.

Label: developmentally preceded by
Description: This relation groups together various other developmental relations. It is fairly generic, encompassing induction, developmental contribution and direct and transitive develops from

Label: acts upstream of
Description: c acts upstream of p if and only if c enables some f that is involved in p' and p' occurs chronologically before p, is not part of p, and affects the execution of p. c is a material entity and f, p, p' are processes.

Label: acts upstream of or within
Description: c acts upstream of or within p if c is enables f, and f is causally upstream of or within p. c is a material entity and p is an process.

Label: developmentally replaces
Description: x developmentally replaces y if and only if there is some developmental process that causes x to move or to cease to exist, and for the site that was occupied by x to become occupied by y, where y either comes into existence in this site or moves to this site from somewhere else Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 21 owl:Restrictions.

Label: developmentally succeeded by
Description: Inverse of developmentally preceded by

Label: expresses
Description: y expresses x if and only if there is a gene expression process (GO:0010467) that occurs in y, and one of the following holds: (i) x is a gene, and x is transcribed into a transcript as part of the gene expression process (ii) x is a transcript, and x was transcribed from a gene as part of the gene expression process (iii) x is a mature gene product (protein or RNA), and x was translated or otherwise processed from a transcript that was transcribed as part of the gene expression process. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 8,951 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in developmental progression of
Description: p results in the developmental progression of s iff p is a developmental process and s is an anatomical entity and p causes s to undergo a change in state at some point along its natural developmental cycle (this cycle starts with its formation, through the mature structure, and ends with its loss). Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 268 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in development of
Description: p 'results in development of' c if and only if p is a developmental process and p results in the state of c changing from its initial state as a primordium or anlage through its mature state and to its final state. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 3,080 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in formation of anatomical entity
Description: Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 874 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in morphogenesis of
Description: The relationship that links an entity with the process that results in the formation and shaping of that entity over time from an immature to a mature state. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,564 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in maturation of
Description: The relationship that links an entity with a process that results in the progression of the entity over time that is independent of changes in it's shape and results in an end point state of that entity. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 308 owl:Restrictions.

Label: causally upstream of, positive effect
Description: holds between x and y if and only if x is causally upstream of y and the progression of x increases the frequency, rate or extent of y

Label: causally upstream of, negative effect
Description: p is causally upstream of, negative effect q iff p is casually upstream of q, and the execution of p decreases the execution of q.

Label: has exposure stimulus
Description: A relationship between an exposure event or process and any agent, stimulus, activity, or event that causally effects an organism and interacts with an exposure receptor during an exposure event. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 6,108 owl:Restrictions.

Label: characteristic of part of
Description: q characteristic of part of w if and only if there exists some p such that q inheres in p and p part of w. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 36,016 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in acquisition of features of
Description: The relationship that links a specified entity with the process that results in an unspecified entity acquiring the features and characteristics of the specified entity Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,340 owl:Restrictions.

Label: evolutionarily related to
Description: A relationship that holds via some environmental process

Label: ecologically related to
Description: A relationship that is mediated in some way by the environment or environmental feature (ENVO:00002297) Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2 owl:Restrictions.

Label: confers advantage in
Description: Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 12 owl:Restrictions.

Label: mereotopologically related to
Description: A mereological relationship or a topological relationship

Label: mereotopologically related to
Description: A mereological relationship or a topological relationship

Label: developmentally related to
Description: A relationship that holds between entities participating in some developmental process (GO:0032502)

Label: functionally related to
Description: A grouping relationship for any relationship directly involving a function, or that holds because of a function of one of the related entities. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 8 owl:Restrictions.

Label: functionally related to
Description: A grouping relationship for any relationship directly involving a function, or that holds because of a function of one of the related entities. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 8 owl:Restrictions.

Label: part of structure that is capable of
Description: this relation holds between c and p when c is part of some c', and c' is capable of p.

Label: genomically related to
Description: holds between two entities when some genome-level process such as gene expression is involved. This includes transcriptional, spliceosomal events. These relations can be used between either macromolecule entities (such as regions of nucleic acid) or between their abstract informational counterparts.

Label: involved in
Description: c involved_in p if and only if c enables some process p', and p' is part of p Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 6 owl:Restrictions.

Label: regulates levels of
Description: p regulates levels of c if p regulates some amount (PATO:0000070) of c Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 256 owl:Restrictions.

Label: regulated by
Description: inverse of regulates Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 22 owl:Restrictions.

Label: related via localization to
Description: A relationship that holds via some process of localization

Label: has target start location
Description: This relationship holds between p and l when p is a transport or localization process in which the outcome is to move some cargo c from some initial location l to some destination. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 810 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has target end location
Description: This relationship holds between p and l when p is a transport or localization process in which the outcome is to move some cargo c from a an initial location to some destination l. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,656 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in transport along
Description: Holds between p and l when p is a transportation or localization process and the outcome of this process is to move c from one location to another, and the route taken by c follows a path that is aligned_with l Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 112 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in transport across
Description: Holds between p and m when p is a transportation or localization process and the outcome of this process is to move c from one location to another, and the route taken by c follows a path that crosses m. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 700 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in growth of
Description: Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 112 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in transport to from or in
Description: Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 82 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in commitment to
Description: p 'results in commitment to' c if and only if p is a developmental process and c is a cell and p results in the state of c changing such that is can only develop into a single cell type. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 246 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in determination of
Description: p 'results in determination of' c if and only if p is a developmental process and c is a cell and p results in the state of c changing to be determined. Once a cell becomes determined, it becomes committed to differentiate down a particular pathway regardless of its environment. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 100 owl:Restrictions.

Label: member of
Description: is member of is a mereological relation between a item and a collection. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 4,754 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has member
Description: has member is a mereological relation between a collection and an item. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,023 owl:Restrictions.

Label: input of
Description: inverse of has input Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 10 owl:Restrictions.

Label: output of
Description: inverse of has output Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,206 owl:Restrictions.

Label: formed as result of
Description: Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 230 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in structural organization of
Description: A relationship between a process and an anatomical entity such that the process contributes to the act of creating the structural organization of the anatomical entity. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 144 owl:Restrictions.

Label: results in specification of
Description: The relationship linking a cell and its participation in a process that results in the fate of the cell being specified. Once specification has taken place, a cell will be committed to differentiate down a specific pathway if left in its normal environment. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 136 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has dendrite location
Description: Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2 owl:Restrictions.

Label: attached to
Description: a is attached to b if and only if a and b are discrete objects or object parts, and there are physical connections between a and b such that a force pulling a will move b, or a force pulling b will move a Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,125 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has muscle origin
Description: m has_muscle_origin s iff m is attached_to s, and it is the case that when m contracts, s does not move. The site of the origin tends to be more proximal and have greater mass than what the other end attaches to. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 619 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has muscle insertion
Description: m has_muscle_insertion s iff m is attaches_to s, and it is the case that when m contracts, s moves. Insertions are usually connections of muscle via tendon to bone. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 668 owl:Restrictions.

Label: derived from ancestral fusion of
Description: A has_fused_element B does not imply that A has_part some B: rather than A has_part some B', where B' that has some evolutionary relationship to B. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 181 owl:Restrictions.

Label: in branching relationship with
Description: A relationship that holds between two material entities in a system of connected structures, where the branching relationship holds based on properties of the connecting network.

Label: tributary of
Description: x tributary_of y if and only if x a channel for the flow of a substance into y, where y is larger than x. If x and y are hydrographic features, then y is the main stem of a river, or a lake or bay, but not the sea or ocean. If x and y are anatomical, then y is a vein. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 393 owl:Restrictions.

Label: distributary of
Description: This is both a mereotopological relationship and a relationship defined in connection to processes. It concerns both the connecting structure, and how this structure is disposed to causally affect flow processes Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 100 owl:Restrictions.

Label: branching part of
Description: x is a branching part of y if and only if x is part of y and x is connected directly or indirectly to the main stem of y Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 263 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has developmental potential involving
Description: x has developmental potential involving y iff x is capable of a developmental process with output y. y may be the successor of x, or may be a different structure in the vicinity (as for example in the case of developmental induction).

Label: has potential to developmentally contribute to
Description: x has potential to developmentrally contribute to y iff x developmentally contributes to y or x is capable of developmentally contributing to y Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 48 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has potential to develop into
Description: This relation has a stronger meaning than merely indicating that X may develop into Y, in that the capability of developing into Y is always present, even if X does not always actually develop into Y. In particular, this means that if Y is restricted to a given taxon T, X is necessarily likewise restricted. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 671 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has potential to directly develop into
Description: x has potential to directly develop into y iff x directly develops into y or x is capable of directly developing into y Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2 owl:Restrictions.

Label: indirectly negatively regulates
Description: p indirectly negatively regulates q iff p is indirectly causally upstream of q and p negatively regulates q.

Label: causally related to
Description: relation that links two events, processes, states, or objects such that one event, process, state, or object (a cause) contributes to the production of another event, process, state, or object (an effect) where the cause is partly or wholly responsible for the effect, and the effect is partly or wholly dependent on the cause.

Label: causally related to
Description: relation that links two events, processes, states, or objects such that one event, process, state, or object (a cause) contributes to the production of another event, process, state, or object (an effect) where the cause is partly or wholly responsible for the effect, and the effect is partly or wholly dependent on the cause.

Label: causally upstream of
Description: p is causally upstream of q iff p is causally related to q, the end of p precedes the end of q, and p is not an occurrent part of q. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 6 owl:Restrictions.

Label: immediately causally upstream of
Description: p is immediately causally upstream of q iff p is causally upstream of q, and the end of p is coincident with the beginning of q. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 8 owl:Restrictions.

Label: causally upstream of or within
Description: p is 'causally upstream or within' q iff p is causally related to q, and the end of p precedes, or is coincident with, the end of q. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 22 owl:Restrictions.

Label: causally downstream of or within
Description: inverse of causally upstream of or within Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 32 owl:Restrictions.

Label: involved in regulation of
Description: c involved in regulation of p if c is involved in some p' and p' regulates some p Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2 owl:Restrictions.

Label: involved in negative regulation of
Description: c involved in regulation of p if c is involved in some p' and p' negatively regulates some p Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2 owl:Restrictions.

Label: involved in or involved in regulation of
Description: c involved in or regulates p if and only if either (i) c is involved in p or (ii) c is involved in regulation of p

Label: contributes to morphology of
Description: p contributes to morphology of w if and only if a change in the morphology of p entails a change in the morphology of w. Examples: every skull contributes to morphology of the head which it is a part of. Counter-example: nuclei do not generally contribute to the morphology of the cell they are part of, as they are buffered by cytoplasm. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,264 owl:Restrictions.

Label: transmitted by
Description: A relationship that holds between a disease and organism Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 172 owl:Restrictions.

Label: helper property (not for use in curation)
composed primarily of
Description: x composed_primarily_of y if and only if more than half of the mass of x is made from y or units of the same type as y. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,449 owl:Restrictions.

Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 14 owl:Restrictions.

Label: is conjugate base of

This is a transitive relationship and follows this design pattern: https://oborel.github.io/obo-relations/direct-and-indirect-relations. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 8,645 owl:Restrictions.

Label: is conjugate acid of

This is a transitive relationship and follows this design pattern: https://oborel.github.io/obo-relations/direct-and-indirect-relations. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 8,642 owl:Restrictions.

Label: is tautomer of
Description: Two chemicals are tautomers if they can be readily interconverted. This commonly refers to prototropy in which a hydrogen's position is changed, such as between ketones and enols. This is also often observed in heterocyclic rings, e.g., ones containing nitrogens and/or have aryl functional groups containing heteroatoms. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,946 owl:Restrictions.

Label: is substituent group from
Description: Group A is a substituent group from Chemical B if A represents the functional part of A and includes information about where it is connected. A is not itself a chemical with a fully formed chemical graph, but is rather a partial graph with one or more connection points that can be used to attach to another chemical graph, typically as a functionalization. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,289 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has functional parent
Description: Chemical A has functional parent Chemical B if there is chemical transformation through which chemical B can be produced from chemical A. For example, the relationship between a salt and a freebased compound is a "has functional parent" relationship. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 20,132 owl:Restrictions.

Label: is enantiomer of
Description: Chemicals A and B are enantiomers if they share the same molecular graph except the change of the configuration of substituents around exactly one chiral center. A chemical with no chiral centers can not have an enantiomer. A chemical with multiple chiral centers can have multiple enantiomers, but its enantiomers are not themselves enantiomers (they are diastereomers). Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 2,820 owl:Restrictions.

Label: has parent hydride
Description: Chemical A has parent hydride Chemical B if there exists a molecular graphical transformation where functional groups on A are replaced with hydrogens in order to yield B. Also used inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1,823 owl:Restrictions.

Label: phalanx number
Description: Most land mammals including humans have a 2-3-3-3-3 formula in both the hands (or paws) and feet. Primitive reptiles typically had the formula 2-3-4-4-5, and this pattern, with some modification, remained in many later reptiles and in the mammal-like reptiles. Label: vertebra number

Label: somite number

Label: rhombomere number

Label: tooth number
Description: x tooth_number N if and only if (i) x is a tooth, and (ii) x is ancestrally tooth number N in a series of teeth repeated along an anterior-posterior axis, typically on the lateral side of a structure such as a jaw, with tooth_number 1 being the anteriormost. Note that this count refers to the total number of teeth starting from the first, regardless of the type of tooth. Corresponds to the label for the biolink entity type class. * In a neo4j database this MAY correspond to the neo4j label tag. * In an RDF database it should be a biolink model class URI. This field is multi-valued. It should include values for ancestors of the biolink class; for example, a protein such as Shh would have category values `biolink:Protein`, `biolink:GeneProduct`, `biolink:MolecularEntity`, ... In an RDF database, nodes will typically have an rdf:type triples. This can be to the most specific biolink class, or potentially to a class more specific than something in biolink. For example, a sequence feature `f` may have a rdf:type assertion to a SO class such as TF_binding_site, which is more specific than anything in biolink. Here we would have categories {biolink:GenomicEntity, biolink:MolecularEntity, biolink:NamedThing}

Label: has specified value

Label: has assay target context

Label: abscised from
Description: A relationship between two plant structures p and q such that q 'abscised from' p indicates that plant structure q was formerly a part of p and that q was removed from p due to some abscission process. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: quality datum of

Label: is or was part of
Description: A relationship that indicates the object was part of the subject at some point in time, but might no longer be so. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: disposition of

Note that this relation is now removed from BFO2020. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: is allergic trigger for

Label: is autoimmune trigger for

Label: has allergic trigger

Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: cell expresses

Label: regulates transport of
Description: A relationship that holds between a process that regulates a transport process and the entity transported by that process. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has regulatory component activity
Description: A 'has regulatory component activity' B if A and B are GO molecular functions (GO_0003674), A has_component B and A is regulated by B. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has negative regulatory component activity
Description: By convention GO molecular functions are classified by their effector function. Internal regulatory functions are treated as components. For example, NMDA glutmate receptor activity is a cation channel activity with positive regulatory component 'glutamate binding' and negative regulatory components including 'zinc binding' and 'magnesium binding'. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has positive regulatory component activity
Description: By convention GO molecular functions are classified by their effector function and internal regulatory functions are treated as components. So, for example calmodulin has a protein binding activity that has positive regulatory component activity calcium binding activity. Receptor tyrosine kinase activity is a tyrosine kinase activity that has positive regulatory component 'ligand binding'. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has necessary component activity
Description: A has necessary component activity B if A and B are GO molecular functions (GO_0003674), A has_component B and B is necessary for A. For example, ATPase coupled transporter activity has necessary component ATPase activity; transcript factor activity has necessary component DNA binding activity. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has component activity
Description: A 'has component activity' B if A is A and B are molecular functions (GO_0003674) and A has_component B. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has component process
Description: w 'has process component' p if p and w are processes, w 'has part' p and w is such that it can be directly disassembled into into n parts p, p2, p3, ..., pn, where these parts are of similar type. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has ligand
Description: A relationship that holds between between a receptor and an chemical entity, typically a small molecule or peptide, that carries information between cells or compartments of a cell and which binds the receptor and regulates its effector function. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: transports
Description: Holds between p and c when p is a transport process or transporter activity and the outcome of this p is to move c from one location to another. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: directly regulated by
Description: Process(P2) is directly regulated by process(P1) iff: P1 regulates P2 via direct physical interaction between an agent executing P1 (or some part of P1) and an agent executing P2 (or some part of P2). For example, if protein A has protein binding activity(P1) that targets protein B and this binding regulates the kinase activity (P2) of protein B then P1 directly regulates P2. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: directly negatively regulated by
Description: Process(P2) is directly negatively regulated by process(P1) iff: P1 negatively regulates P2 via direct physical interaction between an agent executing P1 (or some part of P1) and an agent executing P2 (or some part of P2). For example, if protein A has protein binding activity(P1) that targets protein B and this binding negatively regulates the kinase activity (P2) of protein B then P2 directly negatively regulated by P1. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: directly positively regulated by
Description: Process(P2) is directly postively regulated by process(P1) iff: P1 positively regulates P2 via direct physical interaction between an agent executing P1 (or some part of P1) and an agent executing P2 (or some part of P2). For example, if protein A has protein binding activity(P1) that targets protein B and this binding positively regulates the kinase activity (P2) of protein B then P2 is directly postively regulated by P1. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has effector activity
Description: This relation is designed for constructing compound molecular functions, typically in combination with one or more regulatory component activity relations. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: in register with
Description: A relationship that holds between two images, A and B, where: A depicts X; B depicts Y; X and Y are both of type T' C is a 2 layer image consiting of layers A and B; A and B are aligned in C according to a shared co-ordinate framework so that common features of X and Y are co-incident with each other. Note: A and B may be 2D or 3D. Examples include: the relationship between two channels collected simultaneously from a confocal microscope; the relationship between an image dpeicting X and a painted annotation layer that delineates regions of X; the relationship between the tracing of a neuron on an EM stack and the co-ordinate space of the stack; the relationship between two separately collected images that have been brought into register via some image registration software. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has increased age-specific mortality rate
Description: This could be used to record the increased infant morality rate in some population compared to wild-type. For examples of usage see http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FBcv_0000351 and subclasses. Used only inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 173 owl:Restrictions; never asserted as a direct triple.

Label: before
Description: t1 before t2 iff:= t1 before_or_simulataneous_with t2 and not (t1 simultaeous_with t2) Used only inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 4 owl:Restrictions; never asserted as a direct triple.

No re-use under this ID AFAIK, but leaving note here in case we run in to clashes down the line. Official ID now chosen from DOS ID range. Label: has derived by descendant
